mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by > 0.1% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated CPIAUCSL above 244.5 index level signals imminent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 244.5.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in industrial production (INDPRO > 100) and employment (PAYEMS > 146000) indicate robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where both INDPRO > 100 and PAYEMS > 146000.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, housing starts (HOUST > 1250) signal strong consumer demand, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 1250 during late-cycle regimes.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 17000) reflects robust economic output, generating sustained positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth exceeds 2% quarterly.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO > 100) indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO > 100.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 4.5% indicates tight labor markets, reducing wage pressures and supporting corporate margins, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.5.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS > 465000) combined with low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 244.5) indicates resilient consumer spending without inflationary pressure, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS > 465000 and CPIAUCSL < 244.5.
